summary: Completed comprehensive testing of JUSTICE Platform Phase 6 - Community Evidence Vault feature. Backend APIs: 100% success rate (28/28 tests passed). Frontend UI: All features working correctly. Stats display, tabs navigation, submission dialog, filters all functional.

minor.issue: Returns 400 instead of 404 for non-existent submission (checks upvote status first)
minor.impact: Minor - still rejects invalid upvotes correctly

integration_issues.issue: Community Vault link has 2 matching elements (mobile + desktop), first one is hidden causing click timeout
integration_issues.workaround: Use direct navigation via page.evaluate or href selector with :visible

passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/community/stats - Returns total submissions, departments, officers, top violations
Backend: GET /api/community/submissions - Browse submissions without filters
Backend: GET /api/community/departments?state=California - Filter departments by state
Backend: GET /api/community/officers?min_incidents=2 - Filter by minimum incidents
Backend: GET /api/community/department/{dept} - Non-existent returns empty profile
Backend: POST /api/community/submit - Fails with missing required fields (422)
Backend: Regression - Incidents map endpoint working
Frontend: Community Vault page loads at /community
Frontend: Stats cards display (Total Reports, Departments Tracked, Officers Tracked, Top Violation)
Frontend: Tabs work (Recent Submissions, Departments, Officers)
Frontend: Report Incident button opens dialog
Frontend: Submit dialog has all form fields (City, State, Date, Type, Department, Badge, Severity, Violations, Summary, Outcome)
Frontend: Submissions display with severity badges, violations, location info
Frontend: Departments tab shows department rankings with incident counts
Frontend: Officers tab shows officer rankings with badge numbers and incidents
critical_code_review_comments: Community Vault is privacy-first - no user_id stored with submissions (good design)
Officer and department stats are automatically updated when submissions are created
Upvoting requires authentication to prevent abuse
Public endpoints (stats, submissions, departments, officers, profiles) work without auth
Sidebar has duplicate nav elements for mobile/desktop - first match is hidden causing click issues
seed_data_creation: Created multiple test submissions during testing with TEST_ prefix for identification
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 6 Community Evidence Vault fully tested and working. Public endpoints: /api/community/stats, /api/community/submissions, /api/community/departments, /api/community/officers, /api/community/officer/{badge}/{dept}, /api/community/department/{dept}. Auth-required endpoints: /api/community/submit, /api/community/upvote/{id}. Stats show 10+ submissions, 7 departments, 7 officers tracked. All Phase 1-5 features continue to work (regression tested).

mocked_apis.SOS_SMS: SOS alerts send simulated notifications (no real SMS)
mocked_apis.emergency_contact_notifications: Emergency contact notifications are logged but not sent
mocked_apis.file_storage: Local file storage instead of S3
